notes: Rule-based only. Any YES raises an urgent flag. In pregnancy, NOT_SURE counts as YES. Transcript matching may only ADD a flag. lg text must be written and recorded by a native speaker and clinician-checked.

sets.applies_when: visit_for == child AND age_months >= 2 AND age_months < 60
sets.source: WHO IMCI Chart Booklet (2014), Check for general danger signs; Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023 s17.3.2.1

rules.en: Is the child unable to drink or breastfeed?
Has the child had convulsions (fits) during this illness?
Is the child very sleepy or hard to wake?
rules.note: Lay wording of 'lethargic or unconscious'; clinician to confirm

sets.source: WHO IMCI Chart Booklet (2014), young infant module; Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023 s17

rules.en: Is the baby not feeding well?
Is the baby breathing fast or with difficulty?
Does the baby feel very hot or very cold?
Does the baby move only when touched, or not at all?

sets.source: WHO PCPNC 3rd edition, Advise on danger signs (C15)

rules.en: Fever and too weak to get out of bed?

sets.applies_when: visit_for == self AND age_years >= 5 AND pregnant != yes
sets.source: PENDING: no national adult triage guideline found; confirm with clinician against UCG 2023 Ch.1 or WHO Basic Emergency Care / IITT
sets.standing_prompt_en: If you feel very unwell right now, tell the staff immediately.

rules.en: Very hard to breathe right now?
Fainted or could not be woken today?
